next_stage_rule.GO: Continue nonadaptive disjoint-cohort collection only if the executed source/task instrument remains interpretable and technically intact; freeze all configuration/rubric/source-selection rules before opening reserved bodies. Human labels need not already exist to collect a frozen human-evaluable cohort, but no semantic benefit or independent semantic replication is claimed before genuine ratings.
next_stage_rule.PIVOT: If semantic outcomes are unjudgeable from the actual dossier or reference construction, stop expansion and repair future measurement prospectively without recasting these cases as validation.
next_stage_rule.STOP: Do not expand invalid source material or a broken generation configuration. A valid negative development result is not automatically a stop; do not chase favorable outputs.
next_stage_rule.algorithms: No new algorithm before a semantically meaningful reproducible failure. Generic filtering, history provision or source-frequency prompting is not claimed novel.
next_stage_rule.rq_limits: RQ1 only for this source representation, model and professional cohort. RQ2 only where source/history applicability permits. RQ3 needs controlled size/Base-Instruct comparisons; RQ4 needs fair retrieval/ranking/adaptation interventions. Neither is claimed answered here.
next_stage_rule.validation: At most8 previously reserved English speakers with two contexts and ten conditions each; actual usable source yield must be qualified under frozen rules and separately registered, never forced to eight. Development representation and model cannot be tuned using reserved target content. Speaker-disjoint transport across meeting groups is not evidence of reviewer independence or general-population replication.
